integrity: The all-isomorphism reduction is proved by averaging quadratic forms under coordinate sign symmetries, and the remaining one-variable optimum is established analytically. The numerical checker only confirms the algebraic root and displayed decimal values; it is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to the real two-dimensional exponent-4 Cesàro norm; it does not give the general exponent profile, a higher-dimensional formula, or a classification of all optimizing ellipsoids. Bibliographic searches cannot exclude an unindexed equivalent statement.
title: Exact Euclidean Banach--Mazur distance for the two-dimensional fourth-power Cesàro norm
